items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I was playing for Father Oswald... [INTERVIEWEE] And who did you use in the band? ... George, George, Lawrence Moreira, Slow Dre, Paul Barnes, and Trumpet was Eulie Young.

ctx.x: Yeah, I saw that grand marshal later. Yeah. He lived uptown. Yeah. But the priest would put on the dance down there.
Yeah, Father Oswald. And we built that, see Paul was, then they took Paul and Barnes in the Navy. They drafted him in the Navy.
Yeah, I can see here he's playing clarinet and George is playing alto. Did George play much alto in those days? Well he played enough, you know.
